text: Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to produce glucose and oxygen through photosynthesis. This biological process occurs primarily in the chloroplasts of plant cells during daylight hours. Without photosynthesis, most life on Earth would not be able to survive and thrive in our biosphere.
